releaseNotes:
• Real-time cloud sync for Daily Kharcha (expenses & materials) between UP and Mumbai
• In-dialog date picker and quick 'Today' selector directly in Add Expense / Add Material popups
• Smooth date chip auto-scrolling & scrollable dialogs for all screen sizes
• Automatic synchronization of daily site reports to Cloud Firestore Vault
• Background download manager and device telemetry heartbeat
